examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Label both axes in Gray-code order and allow wraparound adjacency. Form power-of-two rectangular groups of 1s for SOP or 0s for POS. A group may overlap another; diagonal cells are not adjacent. Identify essential prime implicants first and then cover any remaining minterms without covering a mandatory zero.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
F(A,B,C,D)=Σm(0,1,2,3,8,9,10,11). How many literals are needed in its minimum SOP?

**Answer: 1.** All eight minterms have B=0 and allow either value of A,C,D. They form an eight-cell group, so F=¬B. Its minimum expression contains one literal.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
Use don’t-cares only to improve a chosen group; covering every don’t-care is unnecessary. Do not invent don’t-cares for unspecified minterms.

Diagonal cells are not adjacent unless they are also neighbors through valid edge wrapping.
